items.title: Frank Tate interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: Jules Moss was playing drums at the time and then later Ted Moore

ctx.x: Why I can remember that I’ll never know but I guess because the whole thing made such a profound impression upon me. Jules Moss was playing drums at the time and then later Ted Moore, who wound up playing marimba with a Brazilian symphony. A great musician. But we went to work, I went to work with Marian without a rehearsal. It was like McKenna. We didn’t have a talk through. We went up there and hit. Started playing. And things would start to evolve arrangement wise. And of course she already had her arsenal of…
Like you said, that was your Berklee.
